name: tidyCH
description: Curate profile-scoped channel logos and clean channel names, with optional Lineuparr compatibility.
author: ayala

actions.label: Validate Settings
actions.description: Validate the repository and profile-to-folder mappings

actions.label: Preview Logo Matches
actions.description: Create a CSV preview without changing any channel logos

actions.label: Assign Logos
actions.description: Assign repository logos to enabled channels in mapped profiles

confirm.message: Assign matched repository logos to channels in the mapped profiles?

actions.label: Preview Name Changes
actions.description: Create a CSV preview of profile-scoped name normalization without changing channels

actions.label: Apply Name Changes
actions.description: Apply collision-safe trailing-marker cleanup to enabled channels in configured profiles

confirm.message: Normalize matched channel names? A reversible history record will be saved.

actions.label: Rollback Last Name Changes
actions.description: Restore the most recent applied normalization run when channels have not changed since

confirm.message: Roll back the most recent channel name normalization run?

actions.label: Generate Lineuparr-Compatible Lineups
actions.description: Generate normalized lineup copies with original names retained as Lineuparr matching aliases

confirm.message: Generate the configured Lineuparr-compatible lineup files? Existing generated files will be backed up.

actions.label: Show Status
actions.description: Show current progress or the most recent result

actions.label: Cancel Operation
actions.description: Request cancellation of the running preview or assignment
